title: 第17章 识时务者为俊杰第18章 从来没人给我送过东西
slug: 太古封神第1516章直接镇压
lines: 蓝色锦袍男子试图挣脱，但是却发现秦云的手如同金铁一般，无论用多大的力量都挣脱不出来。
“贱种，还不快放开手？再不放手，我让人抄你的家！”
蓝色锦袍男子怒斥道。
秦云沉着脸，手掌猛地扭转。
咔嚓一声！
蓝色锦袍男子右手被扭断了，痛得他发出凄厉的惨嚎。
嘭！
秦云一拳砸在蓝色锦袍男子的脸上。
整张脸当场就凹陷了下去，骨头尽数碎裂，蓝色锦袍男子倒在了地上，只剩下一口气了。
乾素素吓得脸发白，眼泪止也止不住。
“没事了，他不会对你怎么样了。”
秦云对乾素素安慰了一声。
“爷爷，秦云哥哥，你们快跑吧……”
乾素素含泪对秦云摇头，虽然蓝色锦袍男子只是楚王府的一个外亲，但秦云打伤了他，秦云和玄天老祖肯定会被抓起来问罪。
云船还没启动，秦云二人还有机会逃离。
如果他们现在离开的话，然后找地方躲起来，过个十年八年，事情逐渐被遗忘后，他们或许就能逃过一劫。
“伤了我楚王府的外亲，你们就想跑？”
乾凌霄站了起来，一众年轻男女迅速围了上去。
“凌霄哥，是……是我的错，这……这件事因我而起，我愿意……愿意代他们受罚……”
乾素素含泪走上前，她虽然很害怕，但还是咬牙坚持了下来。
“你代他们受罚？你算什么东西，一个侍女生的庶女而已，还敢站出来，你胆子真是越来越大了，给我滚一边去！”
乾凌霄推了乾素素一把。
乾素素差点被推倒在地。
秦云扶住乾素素。
乾素素眼眶通红，越加委屈。
“她是你妹妹，你怎么能这么对她？”
秦云冷冷看着乾凌霄。
从小父母不知，甚至连兄弟姐妹都没有，秦云其实挺羡慕有兄弟姐妹的同龄人，至少相互之间有个照应。
如果秦云有个妹妹的话，肯定会拼死护着，绝不让人欺负。
乾凌霄冷冷说道：“你都已经自身难保了，还如此多管闲事，本世子如何对她，那也是本世子的事，与你有何关系？”
“别说推她，就算是本世子打死她，也没人敢说什么。”
“你刚刚伤我楚王府外亲，已经犯下了大罪，立即给我跪下等候发落。”
乾凌霄漠然看向秦云。
一众年轻男子也跟着纷纷喝道。
“跪下！”
“世子的话你没听到吗？还不跪下！”
秦云看向一旁的玄天老祖，问道：“能下重手吗？”
玄天老祖一怔。
content_en:
The man in blue brocade robe tried to break free, but found that Qin Yun's hand was like gold and iron, and he could not break free no matter how much force he used.
"You bitch, why don't you let go now? If you don't let go, I'll have your house ransacked!"
The man in blue brocade robe yelled angrily.
Qin Yun's face became sullen, and his palms suddenly twisted.
Click!
The man in blue brocade robe had his right hand broken, and the pain made him howl in agony.
Bang!
Qin Yun punched the man in blue brocade robe in the face.
The whole face sunk on the spot, all the bones were shattered, and the man in blue brocade robe fell to the ground, with only one breath left.
Qian Susu's face turned pale with fright, and she couldn't stop crying.
"It's okay, he won't do anything to you."
Qin Yun comforted Qian Susu.
"Grandpa, brother Qin Yun, run away..."
Qian Susu shook her head at Qin Yun with tears in her eyes. Although the man in blue brocade robe was just a foreign relative of Prince Chu's palace, if Qin Yun injured him, Qin Yun and Ancestor Xuantian would definitely be arrested and questioned.
The cloud ship hasn't started yet, and Qin Yun and his two men still have a chance to escape.
If they leave now and find a place to hide, after ten or eight years, when things are gradually forgotten, they may be able to escape.
"You hurt my cousin from Prince Chu's Mansion, and you just want to run away?"
Qian Lingxiao stood up, and a group of young men and women quickly gathered around him.
"Brother Ling Xiao, it's... it's my fault. This... this happened because of me. I am willing... willing to be punished on their behalf..."
Gan Susu stepped forward with tears in her eyes. Although she was scared, she gritted her teeth and persisted.
"You are punished on their behalf? Who do you think you are? You are just a concubine of a maid. You dare to stand up. You are getting more and more courageous. Get out of here!"
Qian Lingxiao pushed Qian Susu.
Gan Susu was almost pushed to the ground.
Qin Yun supported Qian Susu.
Qian Susu's eyes were red and he felt even more aggrieved.
"She is your sister, how could you do this to her?"
Qin Yun looked at Qian Lingxiao coldly.
Qin Yun had never known his parents since he was a child, and he didn't even have any brothers or sisters. Qin Yun actually envied his peers who had brothers and sisters, at least they had someone to look after each other.
If Qin Yun had a sister, he would definitely protect her to the death and never let anyone bully her.
Qian Lingxiao said coldly: "You are already in trouble, and you are still so nosy. How this prince treats her is also my prince's business. What does it have to do with you?"
"Don't talk about pushing her. Even if I beat her to death, no one would dare to say anything."
"You just hurt my cousin from Prince Chu's palace. You have already committed a serious crime. Kneel down and wait for me to be punished immediately."
Qian Lingxiao looked at Qin Yun indifferently.
A group of young men also shouted.
"Kneel down!"
"Didn't you hear what the prince said? Why don't you kneel down!"
Qin Yun looked at Patriarch Xuantian aside and asked, "Can you do something serious?"
Ancestor Xuantian was startled.
title_en: Chapter 17: A man who knows the current affairs is a hero Chapter 18: No one has ever given me anything
